channel.title: ছবির সহায়ক | Photo Sahayak — Photo Guides
channel.description: Practical bilingual guides on photo size, formats and privacy.

item.title: হোয়াটসঅ্যাপে ছবি পাঠানোর আগে সাইজ কমান — WhatsApp Photo Size Guide
item.description: WhatsApp will not send your photo? A step-by-step guide to getting any image under WhatsApp's 16 MB limit, with the exact quality and size settings that keep it looking sharp.

item.title: পাসপোর্ট সাইজ ছবি — বাংলাদেশ ও ভিসার নিয়ম | Passport Photo Size Guide
item.description: Everything about passport photo sizes: exact millimetre dimensions for Bangladesh and international applications, 300 DPI printing, correct head position, background colour and common rejection reasons.

item.title: WebP vs JPG vs PNG — কোন ফরম্যাট কখন ব্যবহার করবেন | Image Format Guide
item.description: A plain-English comparison of JPG, PNG and WebP: how each compresses, which supports transparency, which browsers accept them, and which format to pick for photos, logos, screenshots and the web.

item.title: ছবি পোস্ট করার আগে লোকেশন মুছে ফেলুন | Remove EXIF & GPS Data from Photos
item.description: Every phone photo silently records where and when it was taken. Learn what EXIF data exposes, when it genuinely matters, and how to remove all of it in one click before sharing.

item.title: অনলাইন ফর্মে ছবি আপলোড করার সঠিক সাইজ | Compress Image for Online Form 20-200KB
item.description: Online forms rejecting your photo over file size? Learn how to compress an image to an exact 20KB, 50KB, 100KB or 200KB target for government forms, exam portals and job applications — with the pixel sizes that actually work.

item.title: ছবির ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ড সাদা করার সহজ উপায় | Change Photo Background Color
item.description: Need a plain white or coloured background for a passport photo, a product listing or a form upload? Change the colour behind your subject in your browser — no resize, no install, no upload.

item.title: অ্যান্ড্রয়েডে ছবি এডিট করার সহজ উপায় | How to Edit Photos on Android Without an App
item.description: Edit photos straight from your Android gallery in the browser — brightness, contrast, saturation, blur, sepia and black-and-white — without installing a single app or giving up your photos to an uploader.

item.title: ইনস্টাগ্রাম ছবির সাইজ — পোস্ট, স্টোরি ও প্রোফাইল | Instagram Photo Size Guide
item.description: Instagram cropping your photo? Here are the exact pixel sizes for a feed post (1080×1350), a story (1080×1920), a reel cover and a profile picture, and how to resize without losing quality.

item.title: JPG কোয়ালিটি ৮০ মানে কী? কীভাবে কম ফাইলে ভালো ছবি পাবেন
item.description: What does JPG quality 80 really mean? Learn how the quality number maps to visible quality, where the eye stops noticing, and how to pick the lowest setting that still looks perfect — which is how you cut file size in half.
